title: Kissed Golden German Cheese Casserole
description: A rich and comforting German dish featuring a cheesy, resinous sauce and a crunchy almond topping, perfect for a sick day. This sugar-free friendly casserole is baked to perfection in a bamboo tray.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, saute the chopped onion and minced garlic in unsalted butter until softened.
In a separate saucepan, combine the shredded Emmental and Gruyere cheese and stir over low heat until melted and smooth.
Add the cooked onion and garlic mixture to the cheese sauce and stir to combine.
Season the cheese sauce with salt and black pepper to taste.
In a bamboo tray, create a thin layer of the cheese sauce.
Top the cheese sauce with a layer of flaked almonds.
Repeat the layers, ending with a layer of cheese sauce on top.
Bake the casserole in the preheated oven for 25 minutes, or until golden brown and bubbly.
